author: mikeyk
text: On a thin-frame bicycle riding through San Francisco, in his dressy bike shoes and one-of-a-kind socks, hair flapping under his helmet as we talked about things large and small. Thank you, Peter, for everything.

author: mikeyk
text: Some knew him as the force behind LetsEncrypt, Privacy Badger, and countless other crucial projects at the EFF. Others through his thoughtful AI work. Today we’re remembering him as we knew him best:

author: mikeyk
text: Our friend @pde33 (Peter Eckersley) passed away last night. We’re heartbroken — he was an incredibly rare mix of brilliance, joy, humility, and curiosity. Every conversation with him left us energized to be better humans, to think bigger, to ask more questions, to keep learning.
